question: What is played in a Dhamaal song after blowing into a conch shell?
solution:
The correct answer is **Musindo**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After blowing into a conch shell in a Dhamaal song, the musindo, an East African percussion instrument, is played.
 
• The slow playing of the musindo and the ritual foot thumping marks the onset of the singing and dancing Dhamaals.
 
• The Siddis of Gujarat incorporate these instruments as part of their spiritual musical traditions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baithaaki** - This term refers to a type of Dhamaal performed in the sitting position.
 
• **Lyre** - This is a different type of instrument and is not mentioned in the passage as being part of Dhamaal traditions.
 
• **Table** - This term does not relate to the musical instruments mentioned in the passage.
